rav-shimi-bar-ashi.name: Rav Shimi bar Ashi
rav-shimi-bar-ashi.bio: Babylonian Amora of the generation of Abaye and Rava.
rav-shimi-bar-ashi.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a plain grey-brown mantle, brow furrowed as he presses an objection; background of a mudbrick study hall lit by oil lamps.

rabbi-yishmael-berabbi-yosei.name: Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yosei
rabbi-yishmael-berabbi-yosei.bio: Tanna, son of Rabbi Yosei ben Ḥalafta, of the generation of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi.
rabbi-yishmael-berabbi-yosei.prompt: A sage of the Land of Israel in his 50s with a full dark beard touched with grey and a white wool mantle, an earnest expression as he recounts a tradition; background of a stone study house in the Galilee with olive trees beyond.

rabbi-elazar-bar-yosei.name: Rabbi Elazar bar Yosei
rabbi-elazar-bar-yosei.bio: Tanna whose teachings are cited in baraitot.
rabbi-elazar-bar-yosei.prompt: A sage of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a neat brown beard and a plain linen mantle, pointing to a word in an open scroll; background of a sunlit stone courtyard and a city wall.
